extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism adjudication from primary source sections and figure captions; generic pending framework claims replaced with bounded source-reviewed mechanism claims.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RI18 permeabilizes microbial membranes as shown by dose-dependent propidium iodide uptake in Escherichia coli ATCC 25922 and Candida albicans CGMCC 2.2086.
mechanism_claims.limitations: PI uptake supports membrane permeabilization and cell death, not a direct nucleic-acid-targeting mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RI18 causes visible cell envelope damage and lysis morphology in bacterial and fungal cells by FE-SEM and TEM.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: RI18 against E. coli and C. albicans models
mechanism_claims.limitations: Electron microscopy is direct morphology evidence, but does not identify a specific molecular receptor.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD and helical-wheel evidence support an amphipathic alpha-helical membrane-interaction context for RI18 in TFE/SDS environments.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is structural/mechanistic context; final mechanism conclusion rests on PI uptake plus microscopy.
